title: Palatine Stables
specs: Fenced dog park with separate areas for large and small dogs
Proof of current vaccinations (rabies, DA2PP, Bordetella, internal parasite test) required for dog park registration
Dogs must wear registration and license tags in dog park
Handler aged 16 or older must be present at all times in dog park
Children must be at least 6 years old and accompanied by parent or guardian to enter dog park
Dogs in heat and dogs under 4 months not allowed in dog park

blurb: Palatine Park District manages parks, recreational programs, and community events. They offer a fenced dog park with separate areas for large and small dogs, open year-round. The district also hosts events such as theater performances, holiday pet photos, and running races.
extraNote: Dog park registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable · Field and facility closures due to weather or emergencies are final
